# Copilot instructions for this repository

## PROTECTED: Winefunday social/community section

The Winefunday social/community block in `insight.js` is an approved UI and must be treated as **protected and immutable unless the user explicitly asks to change this exact section**.

### Protected markers and selectors

The currently active marker is:
- `WINEFUNDAY_SOCIAL_V1`

Also treat any future `WINEFUNDAY_SOCIAL_V2` marker as protected.

Everything belonging to the following selector prefix is protected:
- `.winefunday-social-*`

This includes the complete social block HTML generated by the `WINEFUNDAY_SOCIAL_V1` module, its CSS string, event handlers, image-preview logic, Instagram/copy actions, footer links, and mobile rules.

### Approved visual design that MUST be preserved

Do not redesign, replace, remove, restyle, reorder, compress, or regenerate the Winefunday social block unless the user's request explicitly names the social/community section.

Preserve all of the following:
- The visible outer frame/border around the social block.
- The warm ivory/cream background of the framed block.
- Generous inner spacing so content never sits tightly against the frame.
- The two-column editorial layout on larger screens and the single-column mobile layout.
- The compact, centered Polaroid/photo card with its white frame, slight rotation, shadow, gold badge and handwritten-style caption.
- The hierarchy `DU TRINKST GERADE` → current wine name → emotional headline/subline → community copy.
- The three CTA actions and their order: `Foto aufnehmen`, `Auf Instagram teilen`, `Markierung kopieren`.
- The primary dark-green first button and outlined secondary buttons.
- The closing handwritten-style line and the privacy note.
- The Instagram handle `@winefundaysocialclub` and Winefunday links.
- The current responsive mobile margins, padding, button sizing and Polaroid sizing.

### Approved functionality that MUST be preserved

- The current wine name must remain dynamic.
- The Polaroid must automatically show the current wine image when an image exists for the wine ID.
- Image lookup must continue to support `Weinbilder/<wine-id>.jpeg`, `.jpg`, and `.png` plus any explicit image field in the wine object.
- If the guest takes/selects a photo, that local photo may replace the bottle preview for the current browser session only.
- Keep the placeholder fallback when no wine image can be found.
- Keep the existing camera, Instagram/share, clipboard and local-preview behavior.

## STRICT change-isolation rule

For every request, modify **only** the explicitly requested feature. Do not perform collateral cleanup, refactoring, formatting, minification, regeneration, or broad rewrites of unrelated code.

In particular:
- A request about `PASST BESONDERS ZU`, pairing icons, radar values, tasting text, wine data, images, filters, search, ratings, analytics, or another detail component does **not** authorize any change to `WINEFUNDAY_SOCIAL_V1` or `.winefunday-social-*`.
- Do not replace the whole `insight.js` or `index.html` just to change one component if a local edit is possible.
- Before committing, verify that protected social code is unchanged whenever the user did not explicitly request a social-section change.
- If an edit would unintentionally touch the protected social block, stop and use a narrower implementation instead.

## General editing rule

Make the smallest possible change for each request. Preserve existing behavior and styling outside the requested target. Do not rewrite unrelated sections of `index.html`, `insight.js`, `wines.json`, filters, search, wine IDs, image mappings, ratings, analytics, or navigation as collateral cleanup.
